shared_elements: low-relief carving of figures with objects
human figure holding an elongated object (spear/staff or offering)
seated/standing figures with arms extended forward
justification: Both surfaces depict profile human figures in low relief, and in each case at least one figure holds or extends toward an elongated object, but this is a generic correspondence. A shows a single large standing armed figure in elaborate pleated robe filling the whole field, while B is dominated by dense columns of script with tiny schematic figures arranged in small registers facing offering tables — an entirely different compositional scheme and figural convention.
